scripts.server:check: cd packages/protocol && bun test src && cd ../../apps/server && bun run check && bun run db:check && bun run test
scripts.golden:update: cd packages/protocol && VIBEVALLEY_GOLDEN=update bun test src && cd ../../apps/server && VIBEVALLEY_GOLDEN=update bun run test
scripts.web:check: bun run --filter '*' check && bun run --filter @vibevalley/host test && bun run --filter vibevalley-mobile test && bun run --filter vibevalley-web build
scripts.desktop:test: bun run --filter vibevalley-web build && bun run --filter vibevalley-desktop test
scripts.docs:verify: bun scripts/agent-notes.ts && bun scripts/skills.ts && bun scripts/doc-links.ts && bun scripts/stale-names.ts && bun scripts/capabilities.ts --check
scripts.site:check: cd site && bun install && bun run check
scripts.site:build: cd site && bun install && bun run build
scripts.site:deploy: cd site && bun install && bun run deploy
